paragraphs.source_en: With Tokugawa Ieyasu and Maeda Toshiie reconciled, Toyotomi Hideyoshi's funeral proceeded smoothly as scheduled on the eighteenth and nineteenth days of the second month of Keichō 4. The two sides had exchanged written oaths on the thirteenth; once that was done, preparations began for a funeral of the grandest scale.

units.source_en: With Tokugawa Ieyasu and Maeda Toshiie reconciled, Toyotomi Hideyoshi's funeral proceeded smoothly as scheduled on the eighteenth and nineteenth days of the second month of Keichō 4.
units.source_zh: 由于德川家康和前田利家握手言和，庆长四年二月十八至十九日，丰臣秀吉的葬礼如期顺利举行。

units.source_en: The two sides had exchanged written oaths on the thirteenth; once that was done, preparations began for a funeral of the grandest scale.
units.source_zh: 双方交换誓书是在十三日，誓书交换完毕，遂大办葬礼。

paragraphs.source_zh: 由于德川家康和前田利家握手言和，庆长四年二月十八至十九日，丰臣秀吉的葬礼如期顺利举行。双方交换誓书是在十三日，誓书交换完毕，遂大办葬礼。

paragraphs.source_en: At the hour of the Rooster on the eighteenth, the funeral procession left Fushimi Castle, descended the Yamato road, passed eastward along Seventh Avenue, and entered the Great Buddha Hall. Both sides of the avenue were already packed with mourners.

units.source_en: At the hour of the Rooster on the eighteenth, the funeral procession left Fushimi Castle, descended the Yamato road, passed eastward along Seventh Avenue, and entered the Great Buddha Hall.
units.source_zh: 参加葬礼的队伍十八日酉时出了伏见城，下大和道，向东穿过七条大道，然后进入大佛殿。

units.source_en: Both sides of the avenue were already packed with mourners.

ja.t: くからひしめいていた。

units.source_zh: 大道两旁，早就挤满了前来悼念的人。

paragraphs.source_zh: 参加葬礼的队伍十八日酉时出了伏见城，下大和道，向东穿过七条大道，然后进入大佛殿。大道两旁，早就挤满了前来悼念的人。

paragraphs.source_en: Lanterns hung thick beneath the eaves on the western side of the Great Buddha Hall, and bonfires blazed at every crossroads. Advancing in solemn silence, the procession appeared both magnificent and majestic—no observer could have imagined the ugly discord and rancor that lay behind it.

units.source_en: Lanterns hung thick beneath the eaves on the western side of the Great Buddha Hall, and bonfires blazed at every crossroads.
units.source_zh: 大佛殿西侧的屋檐下挂满灯笼，路口都燃起了篝火。

units.source_en: Advancing in solemn silence, the procession appeared both magnificent and majestic—no observer could have imagined the ugly discord and rancor that lay behind it.
units.source_zh: 在肃穆中行进的队列，看上去华美而又庄严——当然，背后发生的那些丑陋的龃龉和恩怨，没人想象得出。

paragraphs.source_zh: 大佛殿西侧的屋檐下挂满灯笼，路口都燃起了篝火。在肃穆中行进的队列，看上去华美而又庄严——当然，背后发生的那些丑陋的龃龉和恩怨，没人想象得出。

paragraphs.source_en: Seventy-five daimyō led the bier and seventy-eight brought up the rear, each accompanied by three to five hundred retainers—a truly magnificent spectacle.

units.source_en: Seventy-five daimyō led the bier and seventy-eight brought up the rear, each accompanied by three to five hundred retainers—a truly magnificent spectacle.
units.source_zh: 灵柩前由七十五位大名开路，后边由七十八位大名压阵，每人领三百到五百家臣，场面蔚为壮观。

paragraphs.source_zh: 灵柩前由七十五位大名开路，后边由七十八位大名压阵，每人领三百到五百家臣，场面蔚为壮观。

paragraphs.source_en: At the center of the procession were the Five Elders, headed by Mōri Terumoto. Next came Oda Hidenobu, head of the Oda house and Middle Counselor of Gifu. Behind Hidenobu and before the monk Mokujiki Shōnin came Tokugawa Ieyasu, leading five hundred hatamoto and four daimyō. Behind Mokujiki Shōnin and sixty monks walked Horio Yoshiharu, bearing the Taikō's cherished sword before the coffin.

units.source_en: At the center of the procession were the Five Elders, headed by Mōri Terumoto.
units.source_zh: 队伍中央为五大老，毛利辉元打头。

units.source_en: Next came Oda Hidenobu, head of the Oda house and Middle Counselor of Gifu.
units.source_zh: 接下来乃织田家督、岐阜中纳言秀信。

units.source_en: Behind Hidenobu and before the monk Mokujiki Shōnin came Tokugawa Ieyasu, leading five hundred hatamoto and four daimyō.
units.source_zh: 秀信之后，僧人木食上人之前，乃德川家康，他领了五百旗本和四位大名。

units.source_en: Behind Mokujiki Shōnin and sixty monks walked Horio Yoshiharu, bearing the Taikō's cherished sword before the coffin.
units.source_zh: 木食上人和六十名僧人之后，则是堀尾吉晴，他手捧太阁爱刀走在棺椁前。

paragraphs.source_zh: 队伍中央为五大老，毛利辉元打头。接下来乃织田家督、岐阜中纳言秀信。秀信之后，僧人木食上人之前，乃德川家康，他领了五百旗本和四位大名。木食上人和六十名僧人之后，则是堀尾吉晴，他手捧太阁爱刀走在棺椁前。

paragraphs.source_en: The lavish, octagonal coffin bore the White Tiger banner on its right and the Azure Dragon banner on its left. Those seeing him off could not help recalling the Taikō's martial achievements and the splendor of his life. The coffin rested upon a palanquin borne by two hundred and sixteen men. On either side of the coffin were one hundred pairs of lanterns.

units.source_en: The lavish, octagonal coffin bore the White Tiger banner on its right and the Azure Dragon banner on its left.
units.source_zh: 八方造的棺椁右插白虎旗，左插青龙旗，豪华无比。

units.source_en: Those seeing him off could not help recalling the Taikō's martial achievements and the splendor of his life.

ja.t: こさずにはいられなかった。

units.source_zh: 送行之人不禁追忆起太阁生前的武功与奢华。

units.source_en: The coffin rested upon a palanquin borne by two hundred and sixteen men.
units.source_zh: 棺椁放置于舆上，抬舆之人为二百又十六人。

units.source_en: On either side of the coffin were one hundred pairs of lanterns.
units.source_zh: 棺椁两边，各有照明灯笼一百对。

paragraphs.source_zh: 八方造的棺椁右插白虎旗，左插青龙旗，豪华无比。送行之人不禁追忆起太阁生前的武功与奢华。棺椁放置于舆上，抬舆之人为二百又十六人。棺椁两边，各有照明灯笼一百对。

paragraphs.source_en: When the procession reached the Great Buddha Hall, the imperial envoys were already waiting. The chief envoy was Minister of the Right Kikutei, and his deputy was Major Counselor Hirohashi.

units.source_en: When the procession reached the Great Buddha Hall, the imperial envoys were already waiting.
units.source_zh: 队伍行进至大佛殿，敕使早已恭候于此。

units.source_en: The chief envoy was Minister of the Right Kikutei, and his deputy was Major Counselor Hirohashi.
units.source_zh: 正使为菊亭右大臣、副使为广桥大纳言。

paragraphs.source_zh: 队伍行进至大佛殿，敕使早已恭候于此。正使为菊亭右大臣、副使为广桥大纳言。

paragraphs.source_en: By the time the sumptuous coffin, encrusted with gold, silver, and jewels and containing the Taikō's remains, was finally installed in the Great Buddha Hall, the eastern sky had begun to pale.

units.source_en: By the time the sumptuous coffin, encrusted with gold, silver, and jewels and containing the Taikō's remains, was finally installed in the Great Buddha Hall, the eastern sky had begun to pale.
units.source_zh: 当镶满金银珠宝、装着太阁遗骨的豪华棺椁最后被安置于大佛殿时，东方已经泛白。

paragraphs.source_zh: 当镶满金银珠宝、装着太阁遗骨的豪华棺椁最后被安置于大佛殿时，东方已经泛白。

paragraphs.source_en: The funeral was overseen by the three men who had arrived first: Kuroda Kai-no-kami Nagamasa, Katagiri Shuzen, and Iio Bungo-no-kami. Until then, all three had been anxious about the weather; only now could they breathe easily.

units.source_en: The funeral was overseen by the three men who had arrived first: Kuroda Kai-no-kami Nagamasa, Katagiri Shuzen, and Iio Bungo-no-kami.
units.source_zh: 主持此次葬礼的，乃是最先赶到的黑田甲斐守长政和片桐主膳、饭尾丰后守三人。

units.source_en: Until then, all three had been anxious about the weather; only now could they breathe easily.
units.source_zh: 此前三人一直担心天气，现在方安下心来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 主持此次葬礼的，乃是最先赶到的黑田甲斐守长政和片桐主膳、饭尾丰后守三人。此前三人一直担心天气，现在方安下心来。

paragraphs.source_en: Once the entire procession had arrived, Mokujiki Shōnin began the Buddhist rites. At that moment Maeda Toshiie felt a pain in his chest, and his tears would not cease. Years before, the Taikō himself had held a funeral for Lord Nobunaga at Daitokuji in Murasakino, a ceremony no less grand in scale or pageantry than this one. Perhaps the Taikō was even now traveling toward the Buddha's realm, toward a farther shore in which he himself could scarcely have believed.

units.source_en: Once the entire procession had arrived, Mokujiki Shōnin began the Buddhist rites.
units.source_zh: 队列全部抵达，木食上人开始主持佛事。

units.source_en: At that moment Maeda Toshiie felt a pain in his chest, and his tears would not cease.
units.source_zh: 此时前田利家只觉胸口疼痛，泪水怎么也止不住。

units.source_en: Years before, the Taikō himself had held a funeral for Lord Nobunaga at Daitokuji in Murasakino, a ceremony no less grand in scale or pageantry than this one.
units.source_zh: 先前，太阁亦曾亲自在紫野大德寺，为信长公举行过规模和阵势决不亚于今日情形的葬礼。

units.source_en: Perhaps the Taikō was even now traveling toward the Buddha's realm, toward a farther shore in which he himself could scarcely have believed.

ja.t: にいるのかもしれない。

units.source_zh: 或许，太阁现也正在去往佛国的路上，去往他自己都难以相信的彼岸。

paragraphs.source_zh: 队列全部抵达，木食上人开始主持佛事。此时前田利家只觉胸口疼痛，泪水怎么也止不住。先前，太阁亦曾亲自在紫野大德寺，为信长公举行过规模和阵势决不亚于今日情形的葬礼。或许，太阁现也正在去往佛国的路上，去往他自己都难以相信的彼岸。

paragraphs.source_en: Perhaps this very Toyotomi Hideyoshi, guided by Mokujiki Shōnin, was even now hastening to atone for his sins before the Buddha. Such an end awaits everyone. How like a play life is! Toshiie was no exception; illness was closing in on him step by step.

units.source_en: Perhaps this very Toyotomi Hideyoshi, guided by Mokujiki Shōnin, was even now hastening to atone for his sins before the Buddha.

ja.t: わらわになっているのかもしれない。

units.source_zh: 这样的一个丰臣秀吉，或许正在木食上人的引导下，忙不迭地向佛祖赎罪。

units.source_en: Such an end awaits everyone. How like a play life is!
units.source_zh: 人人都有这样的归宿，人生多像一场戏啊！

units.source_en: Toshiie was no exception; illness was closing in on him step by step.
units.source_zh: 利家也不例外，病魔正在向他步步紧逼。

paragraphs.source_zh: 这样的一个丰臣秀吉，或许正在木食上人的引导下，忙不迭地向佛祖赎罪。人人都有这样的归宿，人生多像一场戏啊！利家也不例外，病魔正在向他步步紧逼。

paragraphs.source_en: Dawn broke. Yet the chanting of sutras continued without end. For the first three days, solemn memorial offerings would be made; only during the following three would ordinary people be admitted to mourn and pay their respects, after which came the service on the seventh day.

units.source_en: Dawn broke.
units.source_zh: 天亮了。

units.source_en: Yet the chanting of sutras continued without end.
units.source_zh: 可是，诵经之声绵延不绝。

units.source_en: For the first three days, solemn memorial offerings would be made; only during the following three would ordinary people be admitted to mourn and pay their respects, after which came the service on the seventh day.
units.source_zh: 前三日要虔诚地供养，之后三日才允许普通百姓前来吊唁参拜，再之后便是第七日法事。

paragraphs.source_zh: 天亮了。可是，诵经之声绵延不绝。前三日要虔诚地供养，之后三日才允许普通百姓前来吊唁参拜，再之后便是第七日法事。

paragraphs.source_en: Rather than three days of offerings, it would be more fitting to call them three days for the people to view the remains and pay homage. Many would not have time to pay their respects, so the period might well be extended by another day or two. And then the figure of the Taikō would gradually recede into the distance... The thought left Toshiie struggling for breath, his vision darkening.

units.source_en: Rather than three days of offerings, it would be more fitting to call them three days for the people to view the remains and pay homage.

ja.t: ぶほうがふさわしかった。

units.source_zh: 与其说是三天的供养，倒不如说是供人瞻仰更为合适。

units.source_en: Many would not have time to pay their respects, so the period might well be extended by another day or two.

ja.t: ばすことになるかもしれない。

units.source_zh: 许多人来不及瞻仰，恐怕还要延长一两日。

units.source_en: And then the figure of the Taikō would gradually recede into the distance... The thought left Toshiie struggling for breath, his vision darkening.
units.source_zh: 然后，太阁之形象便会逐渐远去……此念让利家觉得呼吸困难，甚至眼前发黑。

paragraphs.source_zh: 与其说是三天的供养，倒不如说是供人瞻仰更为合适。许多人来不及瞻仰，恐怕还要延长一两日。然后，太阁之形象便会逐渐远去……此念让利家觉得呼吸困难，甚至眼前发黑。

paragraphs.source_en: I must not collapse here! He was Hideyori's guardian; whatever happened, he must endure until he had seen Hideyori safely into Osaka Castle... Yet even as he told himself this, Toshiie dared not look Hideyori in the face. He knew only too well that one look at Hideyori would make his anguish still worse.

units.source_en: I must not collapse here!
units.source_zh: 绝不能在这里倒下！

units.source_en: He was Hideyori's guardian; whatever happened, he must endure until he had seen Hideyori safely into Osaka Castle... Yet even as he told himself this, Toshiie dared not look Hideyori in the face.

ja.t: ちこたえねばならぬ……そう
ることができなかった。

units.source_zh: 自己乃是秀赖辅臣，无论如何也要坚持到把秀赖送进大坂城……尽管这么想，利家却不敢正视秀赖。

units.source_en: He knew only too well that one look at Hideyori would make his anguish still worse.
units.source_zh: 他甚是清楚，一见秀赖，他的痛苦必然加剧。

paragraphs.source_zh: 绝不能在这里倒下！自己乃是秀赖辅臣，无论如何也要坚持到把秀赖送进大坂城……尽管这么想，利家却不敢正视秀赖。他甚是清楚，一见秀赖，他的痛苦必然加剧。

paragraphs.source_en: Suddenly, the chanting stopped.

units.source_en: Suddenly, the chanting stopped.
units.source_zh: 突然，诵经之声停了下来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 突然，诵经之声停了下来。

paragraphs.source_en: “Offer incense!” Mokujiki Shōnin prompted Hideyori. Ieyasu still did not wish to open his eyes.

units.source_en: “Offer incense!”
units.source_zh: “上香！”

units.source_en: Mokujiki Shōnin prompted Hideyori.
units.source_zh: 木食上人催促秀赖。

units.source_en: Ieyasu still did not wish to open his eyes.

ja.t: けようとはしなかった。

units.source_zh: 家康依然不想睁开眼。

paragraphs.source_zh: “上香！”木食上人催促秀赖。家康依然不想睁开眼。

paragraphs.source_en: Only under the Taikō's powerful rule could the Five Elders, Three Middle Elders, and Five Commissioners complement one another and uphold the realm. Once deprived of the Taikō, the pillar at its heart, the whole edifice would shatter in an instant.

units.source_en: Only under the Taikō's powerful rule could the Five Elders, Three Middle Elders, and Five Commissioners complement one another and uphold the realm.

ja.t: えることができたのは、ひとえに

units.source_zh: 只有在太阁强有力的治下，五大老、三中老、五奉行才能相辅相成，支撑起天下。

units.source_en: Once deprived of the Taikō, the pillar at its heart, the whole edifice would shatter in an instant.
units.source_zh: 而一旦脱离了太阁这根主心骨，大厦瞬间就会四分五裂。

paragraphs.source_zh: 只有在太阁强有力的治下，五大老、三中老、五奉行才能相辅相成，支撑起天下。而一旦脱离了太阁这根主心骨，大厦瞬间就会四分五裂。

paragraphs.source_en: As Mitsunari pondered this, Nagatsuka Masaie beside him tugged at his sleeve. “Jibu, please offer incense.” Mitsunari rose slowly and only then discovered that Toshiie and Hideyori had both vanished from the seats of honor. After offering incense, Toshiie had accompanied Hideyori away. Only Mitsunari's sworn enemy, Tokugawa Ieyasu, remained in the place of honor.

units.source_en: As Mitsunari pondered this, Nagatsuka Masaie beside him tugged at his sleeve. “Jibu, please offer incense.”
units.source_zh: 三成正想及此，旁边的长束正家拉了拉他的衣袖，“治部，请上香。”

units.source_en: Mitsunari rose slowly and only then discovered that Toshiie and Hideyori had both vanished from the seats of honor.
units.source_zh: 三成缓缓站起身，才发现上座的利家和秀赖都已不见了踪影。

units.source_en: After offering incense, Toshiie had accompanied Hideyori away.
units.source_zh: 利家是在上完香之后陪着秀赖离开了。

units.source_en: Only Mitsunari's sworn enemy, Tokugawa Ieyasu, remained in the place of honor.
units.source_zh: 上座只剩下三成的宿敌德川家康。

paragraphs.source_zh: 三成正想及此，旁边的长束正家拉了拉他的衣袖，“治部，请上香。”三成缓缓站起身，才发现上座的利家和秀赖都已不见了踪影。利家是在上完香之后陪着秀赖离开了。上座只剩下三成的宿敌德川家康。

paragraphs.source_en: After expressing his thanks, Ieyasu turned to Mitsunari and said, “Jibu, you have worked tirelessly these past few days. It has been a great burden upon you.”

units.source_en: After expressing his thanks, Ieyasu turned to Mitsunari and said, “Jibu, you have worked tirelessly these past few days. It has been a great burden upon you.”

ja.t: しかったであろう。まことにご

units.source_zh: 家康致谢毕，回头看看三成，道：“治部，这几日忙忙碌碌，真是辛苦你了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康致谢毕，回头看看三成，道：“治部，这几日忙忙碌碌，真是辛苦你了。”

paragraphs.source_en: Mitsunari bowed formally and replied, “Not at all. It was all done out of devotion to the Taikō. Now Mitsunari, too, may set his mind at ease.” As he spoke, he felt not the slightest pain, a fact that astonished even him.

units.source_en: Mitsunari bowed formally and replied, “Not at all. It was all done out of devotion to the Taikō. Now Mitsunari, too, may set his mind at ease.”
units.source_zh: 三成郑重地施礼，回道：“不敢，都是因为追慕太阁，这样，三成也算安心了。”

units.source_en: As he spoke, he felt not the slightest pain, a fact that astonished even him.
units.source_zh: 说话间，他丝毫不觉痛苦，自己都觉不可思议。

paragraphs.source_zh: 三成郑重地施礼，回道：“不敢，都是因为追慕太阁，这样，三成也算安心了。”说话间，他丝毫不觉痛苦，自己都觉不可思议。

paragraphs.source_en: “Indeed. A heavy burden has been lifted from my shoulders as well.” Ieyasu added.

units.source_en: “Indeed. A heavy burden has been lifted from my shoulders as well.”
units.source_zh: “说得是，我肩头的一副重担也算是卸下了。”

units.source_en: Ieyasu added.
units.source_zh: 家康又道。

paragraphs.source_zh: “说得是，我肩头的一副重担也算是卸下了。”家康又道。

paragraphs.source_en: The funeral had passed without incident, and Mitsunari and Ieyasu appeared quite cordial. Greatly relieved, Kita-no-Mandokoro said, “I hear that Naifu will soon be coming to Osaka. Do not forget to visit me.” Her meaning was plain: she was urging Ieyasu to return Toshiie's courtesy without delay.

units.source_en: The funeral had passed without incident, and Mitsunari and Ieyasu appeared quite cordial. Greatly relieved, Kita-no-Mandokoro said, “I hear that Naifu will soon be coming to Osaka. Do not forget to visit me.”
units.source_zh: 葬礼一切顺利，三成与家康也甚是和谐，北政所颇觉宽慰，便道：“听说内府不日要到大坂来，别忘了去看我。”

units.source_en: Her meaning was plain: she was urging Ieyasu to return Toshiie's courtesy without delay.
units.source_zh: 言外之意，分明是在催促家康赶快向利家还礼。

paragraphs.source_zh: 葬礼一切顺利，三成与家康也甚是和谐，北政所颇觉宽慰，便道：“听说内府不日要到大坂来，别忘了去看我。”言外之意，分明是在催促家康赶快向利家还礼。

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes. As soon as the funeral is over, I shall go at once. Naturally, I must also pay my respects to our young lord.”

units.source_en: “Yes. As soon as the funeral is over, I shall go at once.
units.source_zh: “是啊，待葬礼结束，我立刻就去。

units.source_en: Naturally, I must also pay my respects to our young lord.”

paragraphs.source_en: After Mitsunari left, Lady Yodo remained alone in the cavernous reception hall. Once again, she laughed aloud. But this laugh was wholly unlike the one before. Every person has several different faces. Lady Yodo's alarm at Mitsunari's words had lasted only an instant. Could Ieyasu truly be a venomous serpent with its gaze fixed upon Hideyori? The thought vanished as quickly as it came, and Lady Yodo's heart was soon filled instead with the feeling that she had at last broken free of her shackles. It was truly beyond comprehension.
